title: Caribbean Peril Codes (v2.9)
text:
Caribbean Peril Codes (v2.9)

Peril codes for select Caribbean countries supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

UNICEDE
/2 supports the following codes for
 Perils Covered for risks in Caribbean countries listed in 
Caribbean Lines of Business (v2.9)
.

| Use... | If risks are covered for... |
| --- | --- |
| PWS | Wind |
| PEQ | Earthquake |
